text.title: 不甘心是一种情绪内耗
text.body: 任何一段感情都不可能只有好的，没有坏的，|人在情绪激动的时候容易极端，容易忽略掉别人的好，|加重自己的单方面情绪，任何一段感情都能让人成长，|取其精华去其糟粕，忘掉不美好的，只留下好的，|你会更容易释然，拥有过，经历过，都是一种体验，|时间会冲淡一切。
text.en: No relationship is all good and nothing bad. When emotions run high, people tend to go to extremes and overlook the other person's goodness, letting their one-sided feelings take over. Every relationship can help a person grow: keep the essence and discard the dross, forget what is not beautiful and keep only what is good - and you will find it easier to let go. Having had it, having been through it, is itself an experience; time will wash everything away.
text.credit: 原作 霍贝玛《米德尔哈尼斯林荫道》1689年 · 荷兰黄金时代风景画 · 灰蓝天暖赭土路
